intent: The audit table gets read-down-a-column structure — ruled header, separated rows — the unresolved banner takes notice, the destructive word takes consequence, and a failed outcome is tinted beside its word.
rationale: This is the one screen users read down a column (manifest constraint), and it is currently a bare table: no rule under the header, no separation between rows, cells flush against each other. The unresolved-count banner is advisory — operations that may or may not have taken effect; waiting and checking BattleGrid is the remedy — and takes notice per DT-0011's hierarchy. 'destructive' is blast-radius vocabulary, and the system already has a role for blast radius: the word keeps its chip and the chip takes consequence.subtle, so the flag reads in the same palette as every consequence block in the product. A failed outcome takes color.danger.default on its text — the word 'Failed' is already there, so the tint is a second signal, not the only one. 'Attempted, outcome unknown' stays untinted deliberately: the manifest forbids styling it as failure, and unknown-is-not-zero (system.json) forbids styling it as success; plain is the honest weight. Succeeded stays plain — the normal outcome of a working product does not celebrate itself.

design.layout: Unchanged — banner, then the table in its scroll wrapper.

default.content: Header row: th in color.text.secondary at type.weight.semibold, existing type.size.sm, a 1px color.border.default rule under the whole header. Body rows separated by 1px color.border.subtle rules. Cells take space.2 vertical and space.4 right padding so columns are readable without a ruler. The scroll wrapper is unchanged.

empty.content: Unchanged — plain prose promising future entries; an empty log is an answer, not an event.

with-unresolved.content: The banner takes notice: color.notice.subtle background, 1px color.notice.border border, radius.2, space.3 padding, color.text.primary. role=status stays, above the table, never obscuring it. Advisory, never danger — unknown is not failure.

entry-failed.content: The outcome cell's text takes color.danger.default. The word 'Failed' (and the platform's reason after the dash) is already the first signal; the tint is the second. No background, no border — a tinted word in a table, not a banner per row.

entry-attempted.content: Unchanged — 'Attempted, outcome unknown' in color.text.primary. Deliberately neither danger nor success: the manifest forbids collapsing it into failure, and unknown is not zero.

entry-destructive.content: The existing 'destructive' chip keeps its word and takes consequence: color.consequence.subtle background, 1px color.consequence.border border, existing radius and padding, color.text.primary. Blast radius wears the blast-radius palette.

actor-assistant.content: Unchanged — 'the assistant, answering you', plain text; the historical branch keeps rendering (manifest constraint) and is not visually demoted — who acted is this page's whole subject.

overflow-many-entries.content: Unchanged — the overflow-x-auto wrapper carries horizontal excess; row count renders in full, no truncation or pagination introduced (that would be behavior).

responsive.mobile: The table scrolls horizontally inside its wrapper; the notice banner is full width above it.

acceptance: The header row is separated from the body by a 1px color.border.default rule and its th text renders in color.text.secondary at type.weight.semibold
Adjacent body rows are separated by 1px color.border.subtle rules and cells have space.2 vertical padding
The unresolved banner renders on color.notice.subtle with a 1px color.notice.border border and keeps role=status
The 'destructive' chip renders on color.consequence.subtle with a 1px color.consequence.border border and keeps its word
A failed entry's outcome text renders in color.danger.default; succeeded and attempted outcomes remain in color.text.primary
The table keeps its sr-only caption, scoped column headers, and <time datetime> timestamps
Zero copy changes anywhere on the page
No raw color, spacing, or size literal is introduced

references.value: Backlog 157 (the design lane's tail) — first ticket for this surface. Notice-for-advisory follows DT-0011; the consequence chip follows the consequence-callout vocabulary from DT-0001/DT-0004.
